name: @erplora/app
description: erplora-app (Tauri v2 thin shell). This package.json exists for ONE reason: it makes the Tauri CLI a dependency of the workspace, so the release builds it with `pnpm exec tauri` instead of `npm install -g` — which needs a writable /usr/lib/node_modules and therefore only ever worked on GitHub-hosted runners (hub#878). There is no frontend to build here: `frontendDist` is the committed `shell-dist/` (ADR-0154).
